public static interface MockMvcWebTestClient.MockMvcServerSpec<B extends MockMvcWebTestClient.MockMvcServerSpec<B>>
配置 `MockMvc` 的基础规范，以及围绕 `ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder` 的简单封装。
Since:
5.3

  • Method Details

    • filters

      <T extends B> T filters(jakarta.servlet.Filter... filters)
      Add a global filter.

      这是委托给 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.addFilters(Filter...)。

    • filter

      <T extends B> T filter(jakarta.servlet.Filter filter, String... urlPatterns)
      Add a filter for specific URL patterns.

      这是委托给 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.addFilter(Filter, String...)。

    • defaultRequest

      <T extends B> T defaultRequest(RequestBuilder requestBuilder)
      Define default request properties that should be merged into all performed requests such that input from the client request override the default properties defined here.

      这是委托给 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.defaultRequest(RequestBuilder)。

    • alwaysExpect

      <T extends B> T alwaysExpect(ResultMatcher resultMatcher)
      Define a global expectation that should always be applied to every response.

      这是委托给 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.alwaysExpect(ResultMatcher)。

    • dispatchOptions

      <T extends B> T dispatchOptions(boolean dispatchOptions)
      Whether to handle HTTP OPTIONS requests.

      这是委托给 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.dispatchOptions(boolean)。

    • dispatcherServletCustomizer

      <T extends B> T dispatcherServletCustomizer(DispatcherServletCustomizer customizer)
      Allow customization of DispatcherServlet.

      这是委托给 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.addDispatcherServletCustomizer(DispatcherServletCustomizer)。

    • apply

      <T extends B> T apply(MockMvcConfigurer configurer)
      Add a MockMvcConfigurer that automates MockMvc setup.

      这是委托给 ConfigurableMockMvcBuilder.apply(MockMvcConfigurer)。
